verdict.rationale: Google publishes a public pricing page with a free tier and self-serve prepaid and pay-as-you-go billing, so no sales contact is implied. The docs reference standard per-request costs, with Batch at 50% of standard and automatic caching discounts. Independent community discussion quotes specific per-million-token input and output prices for Gemini 3 Pro and earlier Pro models, which corroborates that per-token rates are public. Missing for 10: a first-party excerpt showing the per-token rate table itself, and evidence that prices are listed for every current model (embeddings, Live, Imagen/Veo) rather than only the Pro tiers.
